canonical_identity.title: Mundari: The myth of a language without word classes

scope: Mundari linguistic analysis; non-Mundarica census stream

identity_verification.basis: ANU repository record gives authors, year, title, journal/source, DOI, handle, Open Access access statement, and downloadable PDF manifestation.
identity_verification.canonicalization_rule: DOI, ANU handle, publisher page, citations, mirrors and downloadable manifestations are one underlying article unless edition/content collation proves otherwise.

dependency_warning: The article explicitly analyzes Hoffmann material as well as new data. Passage/example-level dependency must therefore be tagged before any item is treated as independent corroboration; Mundarica-derived material must not enter the non-Mundarica evidence stream as independent evidence.

rights_access.redistribution_permission: not established by metadata-level audit alone
rights_access.promotion_rule: Do not redistribute or ingest full copyrighted text merely from an Open Access label. Promote only supported propositions/exact locators where quotation/reuse is permitted and dependency is resolved.

evidence_promotion.reason: This run verified identity/access but did not establish immutable permitted bytes, SHA-256, PDF-to-printed-page concordance, exact passage/example locators, and passage-level independence from Mundarica/Hoffmann material.

passage-level dependency classification separating Hoffmann/Mundarica-derived evidence from new data
